claims: The Artemis II crew is scheduled to splash down in the Pacific Ocean off the coast of San Diego.
The Artemis II crew is scheduled to splash down on Friday, April 10, 2026.
The Artemis II crew is scheduled to splash down at approximately 8:07 p.m. ET (5:07 p.m. PDT).
The Artemis II mission is a 10-day crewed mission around the Moon.
The Artemis II crew consists of Reid Wiseman, Victor Glover, Christina Koch, and Jeremy Hansen.
The Orion capsule is expected to begin its reentry into Earth's atmosphere just before the Artemis II splashdown time.
NASA provides live coverage of the Orion capsule reentry.
Major news outlets provide live coverage of the Orion capsule reentry.
